tools.name: search_japan_white_papers
tools.description: Semantic search over Japan's official government white papers: the Ministry of Defense white paper (防衛白書) in both its 2025 edition (令和7年版) and 2026 edition (令和8年版), and METI's trade white paper (通商白書, 2025 edition). Use this when the user asks about Japanese defense policy, the Self-Defense Forces,
